/** Independent verifier: expected frozen in 706c1e4 from APPROVED sources. */
import {test,before,after} from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {randomUUID as uid} from 'node:crypto';
import {readFile,writeFile,unlink,readdir} from 'node:fs/promises';
import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
import {isolatedBooking,write,read} from '../support/h2-booking-isolated.ts';
import {quantityFixture,nominalFixture} from '../support/h2-quantities-fixtures.ts';
import {bookingFixture} from '../support/h2-booking-fixtures.ts';
import {now} from '../support/h2-acceptance-fixtures.ts';
import {decideConversion,type BookingDetail,type ConversionAssessment} from '../../src/domain/booking-conversion.ts';
import type {BookingCommand} from '../../src/infrastructure/postgres/h2-booking-adapter.ts';
let h:Awaited<ReturnType<typeof isolatedBooking>>,b:Awaited<ReturnType<typeof quantityFixture>>,nominal:BookingCommand;
const apply=async(q:BookingCommand)=>h.booking.apply(await h.auth(),write,q);
async function snapshot(){const data:Record<string,unknown>={};for(const {tablename} of await h.observer`select tablename from pg_tables where schemaname='crm_private' order by tablename`)data[tablename]=(await h.observer.unsafe(`select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by to_jsonb(t)::text),'[]') d from crm_private.${tablename} t`))[0]!.d;return data;}
async function negative(q:BookingCommand){const old=await snapshot();await assert.rejects(apply(q));assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(),old);}
async function changed(change:(d:BookingDetail)=>void){const f=await quantityFixture(h),d=structuredClone(f.detail);change(d);return {...f.q,detail:d,evidenceId:await f.detailProof(d)};}
async function nominalChanged(change:(d:BookingDetail)=>void){const f=await quantityFixture(h),q=await nominalFixture(h,f),d=structuredClone(q.detail);change(d);return {...q,detail:d,evidenceId:await f.detailProof(d)};}
async function count(opp:string){return Number((await h.observer`select count(*) n from crm_private.b04_bookings where opportunity_id=${opp}::uuid`)[0]!.n);}
before(async()=>{h=await isolatedBooking('crm_h2011',55487);b=await quantityFixture(h);nominal=await nominalFixture(h,b);await apply(nominal);});
after(async()=>{await h?.close();});
test('R01 AC017 exact 10/12/12/10, one Booking',async()=>{assert.equal(await count(b.q.opportunityId),1);const rows=await h.observer`select service_id,sum(attendees)::int n from crm_private.b04_contributions where booking_id=${b.q.bookingId}::uuid group by service_id`;assert.equal(rows.find(x=>x.service_id===b.detail.services[0]!.id)!.n,10);assert.equal(rows.find(x=>x.service_id===b.detail.services[1]!.id)!.n,12);const nights=await h.observer`select n.night_date::text date,sum(c.attendees)::int n from crm_private.b04_nights n join crm_private.b04_night_occupancies o using(night_id) join crm_private.b04_contributions c using(contribution_id) where c.booking_id=${b.q.bookingId}::uuid group by n.night_date order by n.night_date`;assert.deepEqual(Array.from(nights),[{date:'2026-10-20',n:12},{date:'2026-10-21',n:10}]);assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b04_contributions where booking_id=${b.q.bookingId}::uuid`)[0]!.n,7);});
test('R02 payment unit not attendance',async()=>{const rows=await h.observer`select c.quantity::text,c.attendees::int,c.unit_revision_id,r.definition from crm_private.b04_contributions c join crm_private.catalog_revisions r on r.revision_id=c.unit_revision_id where booking_id=${b.q.bookingId}::uuid`;assert.equal(rows.length,7);assert.ok(rows.every(x=>Number(x.quantity)===1&&[10,2].includes(x.attendees)));assert.ok(rows.every(x=>JSON.stringify(x.definition).includes('fixed group')));});
test('R03 estimated never confirmed by Ganada',async()=>{assert.ok((await h.observer`select certainty from crm_private.b04_contributions where booking_id=${b.q.bookingId}::uuid`).every(x=>x.certainty==='estimated'));});
test('R04 provenance exact full chain per contribution',async()=>{const root=(await h.observer`select * from crm_private.b04_bookings where booking_id=${b.q.bookingId}::uuid`)[0]!;assert.equal(root.opportunity_id,b.q.opportunityId);assert.equal(root.acceptance_id,b.q.acceptanceId);assert.equal(root.proposal_id,b.q.proposalId);assert.equal(root.version_id,b.q.versionId);assert.equal((await h.observer`select acceptance_id from crm_private.b03_acceptance_verifications where verification_id=${root.verification_id}::uuid`)[0]!.acceptance_id,b.q.acceptanceId);const rows=await h.observer`select c.line_id,c.modality_id,c.source_snapshot,c.version_id,c.unit_revision_id,l.unit_revision_id source_unit,l.service_revision_id,s.service_revision_id applied_service from crm_private.b04_contributions c join crm_private.b03_proposal_lines l on l.version_id=c.version_id and l.line_id=c.line_id join crm_private.b04_services s on s.service_id=c.service_id where c.booking_id=${b.q.bookingId}::uuid`;assert.equal(rows.length,7);for(const r of rows){assert.equal(r.version_id,b.q.versionId);assert.equal(r.unit_revision_id,r.source_unit);assert.equal(r.service_revision_id,r.applied_service);assert.ok(r.source_snapshot);}assert.ok(root.chain_snapshot&&root.source_ref&&root.actor_id);});
test('R05 four names explain twelve, not sixteen or eight invented',async()=>{assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b04_participants where booking_id=${b.q.bookingId}::uuid`)[0]!.n,4);assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b04_assignments where night_id=${b.detail.services[2]!.nights[0]!.id}::uuid`)[0]!.n,4);const n=(await h.observer`select sum(c.attendees)::int n from crm_private.b04_night_occupancies o join crm_private.b04_contributions c using(contribution_id) where o.night_id=${b.detail.services[2]!.nights[0]!.id}::uuid`)[0]!.n;assert.equal(n,12);assert.equal(n-4,8);});

async function rectify(f:Awaited<ReturnType<typeof bookingFixture>>){const at=now(),e=await f.f.proof(`acceptance:error:${f.r.acceptanceId}`,f.r.coverage,at),review=await f.f.proof(`acceptance:reevaluate:${f.r.acceptanceId}:Necesidad definida`,f.r.coverage,at);return f.f.q({action:'rectify',acceptanceId:f.r.acceptanceId,coverage:f.r.coverage,at,evidenceId:e,humanReviewed:true,reevaluation:{destination:'Necesidad definida',evidenceId:review,dependentEffects:['verification','commercial']}});}
test('R33 rectification race both orders rejects obsolete versions',async()=>{for(const reverse of [false,true]){const f=await bookingFixture(h),rq=await rectify(f),auth=await h.auth(),ops=[()=>h.booking.apply(auth,write,f.q),()=>h.acceptance.apply(auth,write,rq)];if(reverse)ops.reverse();const out=await Promise.allSettled(ops.map(x=>x()));assert.ok(out.some(x=>x.status==='fulfilled'));assert.ok(await count(f.q.opportunityId)<=1);assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b03_acceptances where acceptance_id=${f.r.acceptanceId}::uuid`)[0]!.n,1);}const f=await bookingFixture(h);await negative({...f.q,expectedRevision:f.q.expectedRevision+1});});
test('R34 early intermediate nights nominal history late COMMIT rollback',async()=>{for(const [table,late] of [['b04_bookings',false],['b04_services',false],['b04_night_occupancies',false],['b04_assignments',false],['b04_history',false],['b04_operations',true]] as const){const f=await quantityFixture(h),q=await nominalFixture(h,f),old=await snapshot();await h.admin.unsafe(`create function crm_private.h2011_fault() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$ begin raise exception 'H2011 fault'; end $$; create ${late?'constraint ':''}trigger h2011_fault ${late?'after':'before'} insert on crm_private.${table} ${late?'deferrable initially deferred ':''}for each row execute function crm_private.h2011_fault()`);try{await assert.rejects(apply(q));assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(),old);}finally{await h.admin.unsafe(`drop trigger h2011_fault on crm_private.${table};drop function crm_private.h2011_fault()`);}}});
test('R35 preservation predecessor and published chain byte identical',async()=>{const original=await readFile(new URL('../fixtures/h2-010/migration-preservation.ts.txt',import.meta.url),'utf8'),path=new URL('../fixtures/h2-011/preservation-run.ts',import.meta.url);await writeFile(path,original.replace("'crm_h2010_mig',55486","'crm_h2011_mig',55490"));try{const p=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--experimental-strip-types',path.pathname],{encoding:'utf8',env:process.env});await writeFile(new URL('../fixtures/h2-011/preservation.log',import.meta.url),p.stdout+p.stderr);assert.equal(p.status,0,p.stderr);assert.match(p.stdout,/V-MIG.*PASS/);}finally{await unlink(path);}const files=(await readdir(new URL('../../supabase/migrations/',import.meta.url))).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.sql'));assert.equal(files.length,30);for(const file of files){const p=spawnSync('git',['show',`d9d76363f5589f83093aff9b802280408b2e890b:supabase/migrations/${file}`]);assert.equal(p.status,0);assert.equal(await readFile(new URL(`../../supabase/migrations/${file}`,import.meta.url),'utf8'),p.stdout.toString());}});
test('R36 pure domain permission and each material guard blocked',()=>{const a:ConversionAssessment={verifiedChain:true,rectified:false,exactScope:true,completeDetail:true,currentRevision:true,authorized:true,ai:false,exactHumanApproval:false};assert.equal(decideConversion(a).allowed,true);for(const key of ['verifiedChain','exactScope','completeDetail','currentRevision','authorized'] as const){const r=decideConversion({...a,[key]:false});assert.equal(r.allowed,false);assert.ok(r.blockers.length);assert.ok(r.ids.includes('SM-BS-01'));}assert.equal(decideConversion({...a,rectified:true}).allowed,false);assert.equal(decideConversion({...a,ai:true}).allowed,false);});
